notes.text: Available in cPanel 82 and later. Returns service, device and server-health rows. Integer status 0/1 and the documented unknown string describe each resource, separately from the UAPI result.
Usage and service values remain strings, including percentages and decimal text. Row fields may be omitted, including error and version; this read does not start, stop or configure services.
